messages:
emma: Hey team :wave: We need to lock the release readiness sync for the next cut. Proposed date: Thu 2025-10-02 16:00 UTC. Can folks confirm availability and whether they want any extra agenda items?
ben: That time works for me. Please add a quick note on canary sizing — we might need more capacity.
priya: I can make it. Will bring infra capacity numbers and recent SLOs.
miguel: I might be 5-10m late, but will join. Can we include a brief runbook sanity check?
emma: Good call @miguel — add runbook sanity check. Also thinking of this agenda template:
```
Agenda (30m):
- Quick status updates (5m)
- Cut checklist walkthrough (8m)
- Infra & capacity signoff (7m)
- Canary plan + metrics to watch (5m)
- Rollback criteria & open blockers (5m)
```
alex: FYI product stakeholders asked for a 2-min demo of the main migration changes. Should that go in status updates or last 5m?
ben: Put demo in status updates, keep the 2 mins tight.
priya: Also request: can someone own the post-cut verification doc? I can handle infra checks but need an app owner for end-to-end smoke.
miguel: I'll take app owner for smoke verification.
emma: Thanks @miguel — noted. Quick RSVP table:
- emma: attending
- ben: attending
- priya: attending
- miguel: attending (may be +5m)
- alex: attending
- ops: TBD
If no objections I'll send the calendar invite with that agenda and attach the cut checklist.
ben: :thumbsup: please tag the release comms channel when invites go out.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: release-cut-deadline in 7 days.
emma: Perfect. Sending invite in ~10m and adding the checklist link. If anyone wants to add agenda items, reply here before EOD 2025-09-25.
alex: noted. I'll add the demo artifacts to the invite.
priya: thanks — will bring the SLO slides.
ben: thanks, see you all then.
